sentences.text:
Shri B.K. Sharma, Public Prosecutor for the
 State/respondent.
Heard on admission as well as I.A.No.2148/2016, an application for stay.

The applicant did not file copy of the complaint and Annexures so that at present no conclusion can be drawn by this Court relating to impugned order passed by the trial Court framing charge of offence under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
The applicant is directed to file copy of the complaint and all Annexures within two weeks.
The case be again listed after two weeks.

(N.K. Gupta) Judge Anil*
